meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成画面自创的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字素材,想快速做成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn articles, notes, or a topic into an explainer video with invented visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have text material and want a quick explainer video.

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记或一个话题)做成无人出镜的解说视频。没有网站可录,画面按每个场景现编,比如排版、抽象图形、图表。产出分镜、脚本、画面文件和成片。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字并要求做成解说视频,比如话题讲解、概念拆解、教程等,它就会接管。要做网站宣传片或意图不明时,分别走 /product-launch-video 或 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这段笔记做成一支无人出镜的解说视频。
say.note: 先给你一份分镜方案确认。

say.text: 用男声旁白讲这个概念,先出草图。
say.note: 指定嗓音,并选择先看草图。

say.text: 这段文字做成 30 秒的 how-to,配轻快 BGM。
say.note: 时长和配乐情绪写进分镜。

howto.what_en: Turns a text (article, notes, a topic) into a faceless explainer video. Nothing is captured, so visuals are invented per scene: typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz. Output: storyboard, script, frames, rendered video.
howto.when_en: Used when you hand over text and ask for an explainer video: topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, etc. Not for website-based videos (/product-launch-video); unclear goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn these notes into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It drafts a storyboard plan for your approval.

say_en.text: Explain this concept with a male voice, sketches first.
say_en.note: Picks the voice; you see sketches before builds.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second how-to from this text with upbeat music.
say_en.note: Length and music mood go into the storyboard.
